observable: Recorded somatic or nuclear calcium-indicator fluorescence supplied by each archive. Model forecasts the next physical-time optical observation in prefix-standard-deviation units.
question: Does replacing one quarter of a fixed training budget from Fish01 with samples from eight freely moving C. elegans improve short-horizon fluorescence forecasts on seven untrained larval zebrafish?
worm_selection: First eight source-approved worm animals, ordered by native recording identifier. Source preselects one recording per animal.
source_crop: First 180 seconds relative to the first supplied timestamp and first up to 32 archive-order ROIs; no outcome-based selection.
calibration: Each ROI uses only its own finite samples in the initial [0,30) s to compute a fixed mean and population SD, with at least 20 finite values and positive SD. Models receive normalized earlier samples only. No evaluation-ROI or donor weight fitting.
timing_rule: Choose the nearest recorded origin to grid times 30 + 1.2*n s with ties to the earlier frame, and require actual origin at or after 30 s. For each feature and target select the nearest observed timestamp to the requested offset from that actual recorded origin. Every timing deviation must be <=0.36 s; no interpolation, no forward input past origin, no row with nonfinite required values. Require actual target under 180 s.
model: One pooled four-lag ridge regression predicts normalized target minus normalized current fluorescence; no intercept, squared error, summed X'X plus n*0.01*I. Add the predicted change to current fluorescence. Float64 closed-form solve once per arm. No ROI, donor, study, time, taxon or calibration metadata enter the head. Persistence simply carries current fluorescence forward.

arms.fish: Shared 768 rows plus 256 additional unused rows from the same Fish01 pool (zero-based even archive-order ROIs, origin <120 s).
arms.worm: Same 768 Fish01 rows plus 32 unique rows from each of eight independent worms; all eligible worm ROIs and origins are available.
arms.fish_new_roi: Same 768 Fish01 rows plus 256 rows from its odd archive-order ROIs, origin <120 s. Within-fish ROI diversity control.
arms.fish_late_time: Same 768 Fish01 rows plus 256 rows from its even archive-order ROIs, origin >=120 s. Within-fish time diversity control.

sampling: For each pool sort candidates by SHA256 on the ASCII string seed|animal ID|archive-order ROI index|origin grid index; take first required count, no replacement. Core and additional fish rows are a split of one ordering. Abort on deficient training slots. Equal unit weight for every row, identical row count and scalar parameter count in all arms.
primary: Mean across the seven held animals of per-animal MSE(worm) minus MSE(fish). Within each animal compute each eligible ROI's mean squared error then average equally across ROIs. Negative favors the mixed arm. All arms and persistence score exactly the same cases. Report signed paired differences and relative to fish baseline, and remove-one-animal estimates. Treat these seven animals as the replication units; no independent-window inference.
secondary: Report normalized MSE for all arms and persistence, numbers of animals improved, ratio to persistence, and normalized MAE. Stratify by recorded origin in [30,60), [60,120), [120,180), and by whether the absolute current-to-previous-lag fluorescence change is >=0.5 prefix SD. These descriptive checks cannot replace the primary result. Log per-recording actual time step, lag/horizon extrema, prefix-qualified ROIs, row counts, and first available forecast. Calibration requires 30 s per new recording; no subsequent coefficient adaptation.
limits: Different optical reporters, upstream source processing, behavior, acquisition and animal diversity confound taxonomic interpretation. The single training fish precludes a multiple-fish training diversity match. Raw time-series extraction may include source-authored whole-record processing. This is an optical forecast on seven fish in this assay; it cannot establish spikes, shared mechanism, developmental or neuromuscular transfer, or evolutionary universality.
freeze_order: Commit protocol, ordered animal split, implementation, and source training hashes, then seal all learned weights and training row identities before source releases any held fluorescence. Preserve failures. Evaluation is read-only with respect to fitted parameters.
